text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service="inference-api" (latency-slo). Region: us-west. p99=2.82s, p95=1.18s. Alert link: https://grafana.company/reports/xyz :rotating_light:

maya: Acked. I'm on it — pulling dashboards and logs now.

ajay: I see a sharp batcher queue growth around 22:06 UTC, KV cache miss rate spiked at same time. Possible hot-key or eviction storm.

leo: Do we have a quick fallback model we can route to? lighter quantized variant to shave tail.

maya: Initiating mitigation: scaling inference-worker-uswest to 10 replicas (was 4). Command: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker-uswest --replicas=10`

ajay: Also reducing `max_batch_tokens` from 4096 -> 2048 to lower queueing latency, applying to batcher config now.

maya: Rolling traffic fallback to `small-quant-v2` for new requests in us-west: `redwood route update inference-api --region us-west --fallback small-quant-v2` — rolling out (gradual 20% -> 100%).

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by maya. PagerDuty escalation window set: 10m if unresolved.

carol: Customer impact check: from logs ~1% of enterprise requests in us-west experienced >2s latency; some interactive apps reported visible lag. No large error spike.

ajay: Noted a deploy at 22:05 that changed KV eviction TTLs. If mitigations don't hold, consider rollback of that deploy. For now fallback + scale + batch reduction preferred.

leo: p99 trending down: 2.8 -> 1.6 -> 1.2s over last 6m. Keep warm-up for 10m and monitor. :thumbsup:

maya: Adding short runbook note in the thread: if p99 > 2s again, rollback 22:05 deploy and re-run cache warmup job `jobs/cache-warmup --region us-west`.

carol: I'll take the 30m handoff if we are stable. Will update customers if we need an incident bulletin. @support-team please stand by.

incident-bot: Pager closed automatically after acknowledgement and observed p99 <= 1.5s for 5m. Please add follow-up items to the incident board if needed.

maya: Follow-ups: (1) investigate KV eviction regression from 22:05 deploy, (2) add throttling guard to batcher config, (3) postmortem if rollback required. Assigning to ajay/leo.

ajay: On it — will triage KV changes and post findings in #postmortems.

leo: I'll prepare a short customer note draft in case execs ask.

carol: Leaving monitoring on. Handoff to me in 30m unless cleared.

maya: Thanks — closing my shift handoff. :white_check_mark:
